doc: A power consumer that only activates sometimes.

usage.doc: The maximum amount of power which can be processed per tick. This might influence efficiency or load a buffer.

capacity.doc: The maximum power capacity in power units.

buffered.doc: True if the module can store power.

optional.doc: If true, this consumer will not influence consumer validity.

booster.doc: If true, this consumer will be displayed as a boost input.

update.doc: If false, this consumer will still be checked, but it will need to updated manually.

multiplier.doc: Multiplier for costs. Does not work for power consumers.
